title: Pale Ale Pizzas, Spicy Chorizo
notes: Recipes created by Krissy Seymour. krissy@fraichecreations.com

ingredientSections.heading: Spicy Chorizo, Chilliwack Corn Pizza
items: ½ Cup Chilliwack corn, cut off cob uncooked
Heirloom tomato and birdseye chilli sauce

methodSections.heading: Spicy Chorizo, Chilliwack Corn Pizza with Fried Duck Egg
steps: Beer pairing: Bridge Brewing Hopilano IPA.
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Crumble sausage into a pan with 1 tsp oil and fry on medium heat until cooked and broken up.

Generously spread flatbread with tomato sauce and scatter cooked chorizo and corn on top. Add dollops of fresh farmers cheese. Place on oven rack and bake for 10 minutes or until crispy around the edges.
Fry the duck egg sunnyside up in oil in a nonstick pan on medium heat, place on top of the cooked flatbread.
